feeds.title: Figure Skaters Online
feeds.description: Figure Skaters Online was started as a way to support U.S. Figure Skating athletes by providing them with their official websites while they pursue their dreams on the ice. Since the 1998-99 season, Figure Skaters Online (FSO) has proudly provided official websites for over 70 nationally ranked skaters. The athletes participate in three disciplines of figure skating - women, men, and pairs, at various competitive levels.
